payload.body: Follow-up from Crate CR-108 verification: the earlier cargo check compile error in frick-server/src/config.rs no longer reproduces in the current worktree; pnpm rust:backend:check now passes from /Users/bri/dev/Crate. The FR-303 product need remains: Crate's Rust scan limiter still needs a Frick-provided trusted client-IP/rate-limit context to exactly preserve CRATE_TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS semantics instead of trusting X-Forwarded-For directly.
